_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Cancelling throws the recording away. In the diff viewer (".diff-viewer-overlay"), "the start button" is data-testid "review-record-start", "the stop button" data-testid "review-record-stop", "the cancel button" data-testid "review-record-cancel", "the status" data-testid "review-recording-status", "where" data-testid "review-recording-where" (its textContent joins its crumbs with no separator) and "said" data-testid "review-recording-said"; "the tooltip" is ".p-tooltip". "Open the diffs" means: wait (up to 30s) for the message input (data-testid "message-input") to be visible, click the "Diffs" button in ".chat-workspace-actions" (if it is not visible, as on a phone, click the button "More options" instead and then the button whose name starts with "Diffs" in ".chat-overflow-popover"), and wait for the commit message. "Wait for the commit message" means: wait (up to 30s) until a ".diff-viewer-overlay .editor.modified .view-line" containing "Rename value20" is visible; the viewer opens on the repository's HEAD commit {{SHORT}}, which renames line 20 of src/app.ts to "const renamedValue = 20;". "The close button" is ".diff-viewer-overlay .diff-viewer-close". "Wait for the clock to tick" means: in an eval with no expectation set window.__tick = document.querySelector("[data-testid=review-record-stop] time").textContent, then wait until that text differs (eval document.querySelector("[data-testid=review-record-stop] time").textContent !== window.__tick, expect true). Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/review and open the diffs.
2. Click the start button; the stop button should become visible.
3. Locked controls look it: the close button should have aria-disabled "true", computed opacity exactly "0.35" and computed cursor exactly "not-allowed".
4. Locked controls say why in a tooltip that outlasts the running clock's re-renders: hover the close button; the tooltip's text should be exactly "Stop recording to close". Wait for the clock to tick; the tooltip's text should still be exactly "Stop recording to close".
5. Hover the cancel button; the tooltip's text should be exactly "Stop and discard the recording". Wait for the clock to tick; it should still be exactly "Stop and discard the recording".
6. The first click only asks, and a double-click is not an answer: double-click the cancel button (one click step with count 2). The cancel button's text should be exactly "Discard?", and the stop button should still be visible.
7. A second, separate click throws it away: sleep 500ms (a confirming click within 400ms of the first counts as part of the double-click), then click the cancel button once. The start button should become visible.
8. The start button should be enabled and focused (document.activeElement is it). The status and data-testid "review-recording-bar" should be gone (count 0 each). The close button's aria-disabled should no longer be "true", and its computed opacity should be exactly "1".
9. Call "requests" should return exactly {"uploads":0,"chats":0}: nothing was uploaded or handed to the conversation.
10. Nothing was left behind to offer as unsent: navigate to /c/review again (a reload) and open the diffs. The start button should be visible, and there should be no review-recording-bar (count 0).
